action.command:
mkdir -p /workspace/.devcontainer/keycloak && cat > /workspace/.devcontainer/keycloak/entrypoint.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e
set -o xtrace

# SPI flags disable theme caching. This results in worse performance, but themes can be edited on-the-fly.
/opt/keycloak/bin/kc.sh start-dev --import-realm --http-port=8180 --spi-theme-static-max-age=-1 --spi-theme-cache-themes=false --spi-theme-cache-templates=false --log-console-color=false
EOF
chmod +x /workspace/.devcontainer/keycloak/entrypoint.sh
cp -r /workspace/apps/startuphafen-backend/src/assets/keycloak/themes /workspace/.devcontainer/keycloak/themes
echo "entrypoint + themes in place"; ls /workspace/.devcontainer/keycloak/
